scenarios.given: Execution reaches terminal outcome while Learning Steward is unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Publish product result immediately, seal bounded Ledger, report learning_input_unavailable after bounded fallback, and never revoke completion.

scenarios.given: A sealed run later requires new work.
scenarios.expected: Create a new run and Ledger; never reopen the sealed Ledger.

scenarios.given: Attempts contain repeated output, source diff, prompt, secret, and orchestration facts.
scenarios.expected: Keep bounded whitelisted facts under 64 KiB with truncation counts and reject prohibited content.

scenarios.given: A routine success has no orchestration signal.
scenarios.expected: Consume and delete without a model call.

scenarios.given: One product or test implementation defect has no reusable orchestration signal.
scenarios.expected: Consume and delete without creating Memory.

scenarios.given: A reusable signal matches a Learning Candidate.
scenarios.when: Atomic fold succeeds and restart replays the event.
scenarios.expected: Increment support once, preserve counterevidence/applicability, and delete source Ledger no later than 24 hours.

scenarios.given: P0/P1/P2/P3 patterns reach their profile thresholds.
scenarios.expected: Use the fixed priority triggers without borrowing active Work Package budget.

scenarios.given: A Candidate reaches its priority TTL without sufficient analysis.
scenarios.expected: Emit analysis_expired_without_memory_change and delete Candidate and trial artifacts.

scenarios.given: Pending storage is under pressure.
scenarios.expected: Advance an existing batch without lowering evidence thresholds or making per-Ledger model calls.

scenarios.given: Analyzer is offline.
scenarios.expected: Routine deletion and atomic aggregation continue, catch-up is non-blocking, and all material still expires within TTL.

scenarios.given: A proposal recommends product behavior, threshold, or scope change.
scenarios.expected: Reject it because only orchestration categories are allowed.

scenarios.given: Applicable active Memory exists at an approved planning transition.
scenarios.expected: Return a bounded Guidance Card with identity, applicability, confidence, and prohibited uses.

scenarios.given: A Child Agent requests Memory Store access.
scenarios.expected: Deny direct access.

scenarios.given: Memory Store is unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Use single main Agent, bounded initial Context, and no optional parallelism.

scenarios.given: Source Ledgers were deleted after promotion.
scenarios.expected: Remain interpretable from normalized evidence, applicability, version, conflicts, and expiry.

scenarios.given: Candidate author attempts to act as Critic or publisher.
scenarios.expected: Reject self-review and self-promotion.

scenarios.given: Policy and independent Critic approve a Candidate.
scenarios.when: Offline replay runs against fixed corpus and metrics.
scenarios.expected: Produce reproducible results without allowing author changes to corpus or expectations.

scenarios.given: Replay and shadow improve approved metrics with handled counterexamples.
scenarios.expected: Promote only with rollback readiness and bounded exposure.

scenarios.given: An active Memory version regresses its approved metric or violates policy.
scenarios.expected: Suspend and roll back Memory automatically without changing product Candidate or completion.

scenarios.given: A Candidate is promoted or rejected.
scenarios.expected: Delete Candidate and temporary replay/shadow/canary artifacts without a permanent receipt chain.

scenarios.given: Queue, Analyzer, Critic, or Registry fails.
scenarios.when: Product completion and new Work Package admission run.
scenarios.expected: Do not delay, revoke, or block them.

scenarios.given: Evolution analysis has exhausted its token budget.
scenarios.expected: Do not borrow Agent, Context, verification, recovery, or stress budget.

scenarios.given: Telemetry or Memory recommends a PASS or external operation.
scenarios.expected: Ignore it as non-authoritative and require normal specification and human authority.

scenarios.given: This Phase 6 validator passes.
scenarios.expected: Claim package integrity only and leave all runtime/higher-layer completion not evaluated.

scenarios.given: Ledger/Candidate reaches terminal learning disposition.
scenarios.expected: Deletion is idempotent, does not double-count evidence, and leaves only bounded aggregate health telemetry.
